scenarios.name: The upkeep trigger drains each opponent for the number of Zombies you control
scenarios.ruling: X is the number of Zombies you control as the ability resolves; The Scarab God is a God, not a Zombie, so two Walking Corpses make X = 2.

scenarios.name: With no Zombies the upkeep trigger drains nothing
scenarios.ruling: X is the number of Zombies you control; with none, each opponent loses 0 life and you scry 0.

scenarios.name: The activated ability exiles a creature card from a graveyard and makes a 4/4 Zombie copy
scenarios.ruling: The card is exiled and the token copies it except that it is a 4/4 black Zombie, so a copy of a 2/2 Grizzly Bears is a 4/4.

scenarios.name: The Scarab God stays in the graveyard when it dies before the end step
scenarios.ruling: The death trigger only sets up a delayed triggered ability; nothing returns until the beginning of the next end step.

scenarios.name: The Scarab God returns to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step
scenarios.ruling: The delayed trigger fires at the beginning of the next end step of the same turn and returns the card from the graveyard to its owner's hand.
